# INTRAVASCULAR CATHETER-ASSOCIATED STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS INFECTION

Catheter removal is required. Obtain follow up blood cultures to document that bacteremia clears on therapy.

Refer to cardiovascular section for suspected infectious endocarditis.
[Approach to Endocarditis](endocarditis-approach-to)

Therapy:
## Consult Infectious Diseases in all cases.

## Duration of therapy

## Inpatient

For uncomplicated infection, treat for 14 days. Longer duration is required for complicated cases.

Refer to [Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia](staphylococcus-aureus-bacteremia) recommendations for antimicrobial
selection
[Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia](staphylococcus-aureus-bacteremia)

## Outpatient

Refer to Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS.
